items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: They had both bands on the stand, Eddie Condon's with Bud Freeman in it, and our band. And there the two bands played together on the stand.

ctx.x: Well, I left him, I think the last job was the Sherman Hotel. Well, now we started doing the hotels. I said the La Salle, and then from the La Salle we did the Three Deuces first in Chicago, and then to the La Salle Hotel, and then into the Sherman. They had both bands on the stand, Eddie Condon's with Bud Freeman in it, and our band. And there the two bands played together on the stand. Then, from there, into Cincinnati, the Netherlands Plaza, downstairs. People were trying to book us on good jobs then. And now…
